categories.name: Places Map
categories.purpose: Map-first personal and team atlas for saving places, classifying them, annotating them and exploring them spatially.
categories.primary_data_model: Place, collection, category, coordinate, note, visit status
categories.core_user_flows: Browse saved places on a vector map; filter by category; search; select a marker to inspect its details; add or edit a place; export GeoJSON/JSON.
categories.implementation_notes: Use a map as the primary canvas, not a dashboard chart. Production version should use OpenStreetMap tiles with attribution and a pluggable geocoder; mockup uses an illustrative local vector map so it works offline.

categories.name: Flashcards
categories.purpose: Spaced-repetition study app for creating decks, reviewing cards and tracking recall over time.
categories.primary_data_model: Deck, card, prompt, answer, review, interval, difficulty, due date
categories.core_user_flows: Select a deck; reveal the answer; grade recall as Again, Hard, Good or Easy; schedule the next review; inspect progress and upcoming cards.
categories.implementation_notes: The review surface is the product. Keep one card central with distraction-free controls and keyboard-friendly reveal/rating actions. Use an SM-2-like scheduler behind a replaceable policy; mock data only.

categories.name: Clinic Booking
categories.purpose: Appointment scheduling board for a small clinic, with practitioner availability, rooms, patient records and appointment status.
categories.primary_data_model: Practitioner, patient, room, appointment, slot, appointment type, status
categories.core_user_flows: View a day by practitioner; filter by location or clinician; open an appointment; create or reschedule a sample appointment; mark check-in status.
categories.implementation_notes: Sample data only. No real patient data, diagnosis, prescriptions or clinical decisions. Use explicit overlap detection for bookings and protect patient-facing data in a production implementation.

categories.name: Budget
categories.purpose: Personal budgeting and transaction ledger with account balances, spending categories and monthly limits.
categories.primary_data_model: Account, transaction, category, budget, period, balance
categories.core_user_flows: Navigate months; inspect transactions; add an expense; filter transactions; export CSV; compare category spend against budgets.
categories.implementation_notes: Use cents/integer minor units for money, preserve currency, and derive totals from ledger entries. Do not connect to banks or imply investment advice.

categories.name: Matters
categories.purpose: Matter-centric legal workspace for tracking clients, deadlines, case activity, documents, tasks and reusable clause references.
categories.primary_data_model: Matter, client, party, deadline, document, activity, task, clause
categories.core_user_flows: Select a matter; switch between timeline, documents, tasks and notes; inspect summary and next deadline; create a matter or activity.
categories.implementation_notes: Demo matter data only. Do not generate legal advice or treat clause snippets as approved legal wording. Maintain matter-level access controls, audit trail and document version history in a real product.

categories.name: Citizen Requests
categories.purpose: Municipal service portal for receiving citizen reports, triaging them to departments and publishing status updates.
categories.ux_direction: Civic request queue plus public status view
categories.primary_data_model: Request, resident, department, location, category, priority, status update
categories.core_user_flows: Filter the queue; inspect a request on a location map; assign a responsible department; update status; create a request; expose a public reference page.
categories.implementation_notes: Keep personal data private and separate from the public status projection. Provide a clear status history, reference ID, accessible resident flow and department SLA fields.

categories.name: Training Roster
categories.purpose: Non-operational personnel training administration for groups, attendance, safety qualifications, renewals and readiness reporting.
categories.ux_direction: Personnel qualification matrix with training calendar
categories.primary_data_model: Person, group, qualification, course, session, attendance, expiry
categories.core_user_flows: Search the roster; filter by group; inspect current/expired training qualifications; switch to weekly calendar; add a person; export a roster.
categories.implementation_notes: Strictly non-operational. No mission planning, targeting, deployment, weapons, intelligence or tactical functions. Readiness refers only to training completion and qualification currency.

categories.name: Point of Sale
categories.purpose: Cashier-first checkout for a small shop, with product catalogue, current basket, tax calculation, test payment and stock decrement.
categories.primary_data_model: Product, category, stock, cart line, sale, receipt, tax rate
categories.core_user_flows: Filter/search items; add product; change quantities; remove line; calculate subtotal and VAT; complete test sale; create receipt and decrement sample stock.
categories.implementation_notes: Use decimal-safe minor currency units and a configurable tax profile. Payment is simulated; no payment processor or card data. Stock changes only after a completed test sale.

categories.name: Shop
categories.purpose: Customer-facing storefront with curated catalogue, collection filters, product discovery, cart and test checkout.
categories.primary_data_model: Product, collection, variant, cart line, customer, order
categories.core_user_flows: Browse collections; filter products; add to bag; view cart drawer; inspect subtotal; start a test checkout; create a sample order.
categories.implementation_notes: This is a storefront, not an admin console. No payment processing or real fulfillment. A real build should support product variants, stock validation, shipping/tax estimates and accessible checkout.

categories.name: Content Calendar
categories.purpose: Editorial marketing planner for campaigns and channel-specific publishing across a monthly calendar.
categories.primary_data_model: Campaign, post, channel, publish date, status, asset, owner
categories.core_user_flows: Navigate months; inspect scheduled posts; filter by channel; create or edit a draft; assign a channel and publish date; group posts by campaign.
categories.implementation_notes: Calendar is the primary interface. Distinguish draft, review and scheduled states clearly; avoid pretending a post was published without a connected provider.
